Intel Core i5-14400F Desktop Processor 10 Cores 16 Threads up to 4.70 GHz

Supercharge your custom desktop gaming system with the incredible architectural advancement of the Intel Core i5-14400F processor. Available at Turbo Computer, this next-generation PC hardware core component layout is masterfully engineered for modern mid-tier competitive esports players, intensive content creators, and professional data workflow operators across Egypt who demand swift computational tracking, enhanced hybrid core management, and great value per computing clock cycle. Built on the refined Raptor Lake Refresh hybrid architecture framework, this CPU provides exceptional reliability for heavy daily application rendering setups.

The Intel Core i5-14400F delivers an impressive hybrid configuration featuring 10 total cores (6 Performance-cores and 4 Efficient-cores) alongside 16 processing threads, operating at a responsive 2.50 GHz base frequency that scales dynamically up to a maximum turbo frequency translation of 4.70 GHz. Empowered by a larger 20MB Intel Smart Cache block matrix, it deeply optimizes internal frame latency structures to accelerate gaming deployment loops. This versatile hardware platform fully supports dual-channel memory configuration channels for both standard DDR4 up to 3200MHz and ultra-fast DDR5 memory profiles up to 4800MHz speeds. Operating at a highly efficient 65W base power target, it draws direct data connectivity from motherboard expansion lanes with comprehensive native PCIe 5.0 and 4.0 standard compliance. Please note that this 'F' suffix variant architecture requires a discrete external graphics card installation to drive video displays successfully.
